definitions.explanation: Happening quickly and dramatically, often implying an extreme or severe change.

examples.japanese: {気温|きおん}が{急激|きゅうげき}に{下|さ}がった。
{急激|きゅうげき}な{変化|へんか}についていけない。
examples.english: I can't keep up with the rapid changes.

examples.japanese: {人口|じんこう}が{急激|きゅうげき}に{増加|ぞうか}した。

notes:
{急激|きゅうげき} emphasizes both speed and intensity of change.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {急激|きゅうげき}な{変化|へんか} (drastic change)
- {急激|きゅうげき}に{増|ふ}える/{減|へ}る (to increase/decrease rapidly)
- {急激|きゅうげき}に{悪化|あっか}する (to worsen rapidly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {急激|きゅうげき}: sudden, drastic (implies intensity)
- {急速|きゅうそく}: rapid (emphasizes speed)
- {急|きゅう}: sudden (basic term)
- {突然|とつぜん}: sudden, unexpected (emphasizes surprise)
